title: De novo generator plus quantum chemistry designs a naked-eye fluorescent molecule
summary: A de novo molecule generator coupled with quantum-chemical computation produced 3,643 candidates; one unreported and seven reported molecules were synthesized, 6 of 8 fluoresced as predicted, and the new molecule was visible to the naked eye. Abstract-level review only; sample of 8 is small.
ai_technology: De novo molecule generator with quantum chemical computation and machine learning

evidence.unknown: Only one new molecule; generalization and the ML share of the gain are not separated in the abstract; full text not read.
evidence.ai_role: A generative model proposed candidate molecules that were screened by QC/ML and synthesized.
